found: UI walkthrough: a learner who refuted 'splitting the difference is always fair' ("...is only fair if the anchors were fair...") was recorded as endorsing the misconception and listed as a growth area.
fix: Endorsement now requires no negation, no qualifier ('only if', 'depends', 'but'...) and no use of the correcting idea's look-fors.
before: 1 misconception evidence record for a correct refutation
after: 0 records; a genuine endorsement still records 1
test: runtime regression: refuting a misconception is not recorded as endorsing it

found: Educator trace listed the same learner turn twice per criterion (challenge record + observation record).
test: trace links teacher input -> design -> evidence -> feedback

found: API test: any error thrown inside a locked handler (e.g. approval without a name) produced an unhandled rejection in the lock chain, which crashes the Node process.
before: server process exited on first validation error
test: approval is enforced by the server, not just the UI

found: An invalid direct edit (removing all key ideas) crashed the derive step before validation.
fix: Validate decisions before building derived content.

found: 'Rename the character to Morgan' (sentence-initial capital) was not recognized.
First-year MBA students were classified as 'supportive' difficulty; the character goal captured an over-long clause; the name was repeated in the description.
fix: Graduate/professional signals override; goal trimmed at clause boundary; leading name stripped.

found: E2E test: when an action failed (e.g. approving without the confirmation box ticked), the error re-render erased everything the educator had typed (name, revision request, edits).
fix: Error handling captures and restores all form values (and the open editor) around the re-render.
before: approver name lost; second attempt failed
test: accessibility + full educator-to-learner flow in the browser

found: axe (WCAG 2 A/AA): low-contrast phase stepper and 'not assessed' badges; scrollable chat logs not keyboard-focusable.
fix: Raised text contrast; chat logs get tabindex=0 and role=log.
after: 0 serious/critical violations on home, interview, design, learner (all phases), and evidence views
test: accessibility + full educator-to-learner flow in the browser
